title: AVA Direction Packet
description: Structured session object for transmitting a director's field to one or more performers without flattening performance intuition.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for the performance session.

character_id.description: Primary character identifier for single-actor packets.

actor_id.description: Primary actor identifier for single-actor packets.

what_must_be_felt.description: Primary felt target for the performance.

subtext_pressure.description: Unspoken emotional or narrative force under the line.

emotional_temperature.description: Concise emotional weather, for example 'intimate but withheld'.

intimacy_distance.description: How close or defended the performance should feel.

intensity.description: Intensity band, for example low, medium, high.

restraint.description: How much force must stay contained.

danger_level.description: Amount of threat, edge, or instability underneath the delivery.

energy_curve.description: Short description of how energy should change during the take.

sensory_anchor.description: One strong image or physical analogy that organizes the nervous system quickly.

reference_images.description: Optional supporting images, metaphors, or visual anchors.

forbidden_readings.description: Readings that would break the field.

counterpoint_note.description: Optional contradictory edge to preserve nuance.

first_take_protected.description: Whether the first technically usable read must remain protected.

first_take_bias.description: How strongly the session should prefer preserving the first read.

redirect_rule.description: Allowed redirect pattern, ideally one variable at a time.

director_notes.description: Additional guidance that does not fit the main field.

shared_field.description: Shared field for all actors in a scene.

role_delta.description: Role-specific tension inside a shared field.
